body.name: Uniform whole-fiber honesty
body.construction: \(\mathfrak C_\alpha(\mathcal M_\star)=\{(S_N)_{N\ge1}:S_N:(\mathbb R^p)^N\to\mathcal K(\mathbb R)\text{ is Borel measurable and }\liminf_{N\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal M_\star}P^{\otimes N}\{\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma(P),\preceq)\subseteq S_N\}\ge1-\alpha\}\).
